css.description: The main color of the element's `data-ok-color`, as RGB channels.
css.name: --ok-c-channel

css.description: The main color of the element's `data-ok-color`.
css.name: --ok-c-main

options.description: Color swatches only (`swatch`): a circle or a square with rounded corners.
options.name: shape

parts.description: The native radio. It covers the control, invisible.
parts.name: data-ok-radio-input

parts.description: The default icons' ring, drawn by the stylesheet (with a dot when checked).
parts.name: data-ok-radio-ring

parts.description: A color swatch, instead of the icons (with `data-ok-swatch`). It holds the check mark shown while selected.
parts.name: data-ok-radio-swatch

parts.description: A color swatch's color: a CSS color, such as `#FF9800`, or a `var(--ok-…)` token. Other values are ignored (the swatch stays grey).
parts.name: data-ok-swatch

react.description: A native `<input type="radio">` with themed icons. In a `RadioGroup` it takes the group's name and selection. `ref` and the remaining props go to the input.

props.description: Replaces the selected icon (with `swatch`: the mark on the selected swatch).
props.name: checkedIcon

props.description: Class of the root span (other props go to the input).
props.name: className

props.description: Color when selected; `default` is the text color.
props.name: color

props.description: Standalone: called with `true` when the radio gets selected.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Shows a color swatch instead of the icons (a color picker): a CSS color, such as `#FF9800`, or a `var(--ok-…)` token. Name the radio with the color's name (`aria-label="Orange"`).
props.name: swatch

props.description: Identifies the radio in a `RadioGroup` (and in the submitted form).
props.name: value

options.description: Radios side by side instead of a column.
options.name: row

options.description: Selected radio (`value` / `defaultValue` + `onChange(value)`; HTML: the checked input).
options.name: value

react.description: `role="radiogroup"`: name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. The browser keeps one radio checked and moves with the arrow keys.

props.description: Name of the radios (default: a generated one).
props.name: name

props.description: Called with the value of the radio that gets selected.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Radios side by side instead of a column.
props.name: row
